core_obligations: Denote by K^wedge the adjoint of the derived-completion lemma; by that lemma it is RHom of the extended alternating Cech complex A -> prod A_{f_i} -> ... -> A_{f_1...f_r} with K (proof lines 26406-26413). By the extended-alternating-Cech-is-colimit-koszul lemma this Cech complex is the colimit of the Koszul chain complexes K^n = K(A, f_1^n, ..., f_r^n) in degrees 0..r, finite complexes of finite free modules whose duals (in the sense of the dual-perfect-complex lemma) are the Koszul cochain complexes K_n in degrees -r..0 (proof lines 26414-26428). Hence K^wedge = RHom(hocolim K^n, K), and by the colim-and-lim-of-duals lemma this equals Rlim (K tensor_A^L K_n), which is exactly the functor K' of the statement; the identification is the claimed adjointness (proof lines 26429-26433).
proof_roadmap: Write the adjoint explicitly as RHom out of the Cech complex (proof lines 26406-26413).
Express the Cech complex as hocolim of Koszul complexes and apply the colim-lim duality (proof lines 26414-26433).
